name: dsfd_vm_bgq_m5-m5-COMMIT
purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed s81b-vm_bgq-sys2s-30327ff97-tc-rd (dsfd_vm_bgq, RTL 30327ff97, snapshot of 1 drifted files): same RTL, outline 253.794x500.04, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:redesign-ds

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_vm_bgq #(.NSTG(2)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src/rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/vm/dsfd_vm_bgq_sys.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: exact_sys
bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 physical/redesign_ds/vm_sys/vm_sys_bench.py {RUN}/bench ex 2 4 -- +CYCLES=20000 +SEED=1
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the 30327ff97 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src]

bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 physical/redesign_ds/vm_sys/vm_sys_bench.py {RUN}/bench mord 2 4 OT_S81PH_VM_MUT_ORDER -- +CYCLES=4000
}
bench.note: [m5rr: run on the 30327ff97 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src]

bench.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_2; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 physical/redesign_ds/vm_sys/vm_sys_bench.py {RUN}/bench mskew 2 4 OT_VM_SYS_MUT_SKEW -- +CYCLES=4000

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsfd_vm_bgq_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_vm_bgq --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
